WITH actor_counts AS (
  SELECT actor_id, COUNT(*) AS film_count
  FROM film_actor
  GROUP BY actor_id
), actor_values AS (
  SELECT actor_id,
         film_count,
         film_count / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM film_actor) AS credit_share
  FROM actor_counts
)
SELECT actor_id,
       film_count,
       credit_share,
       credit_share - AVG(credit_share) OVER () AS difference_from_average
FROM actor_values
ORDER BY difference_from_average DESC
LIMIT 10;
